disposition_reason: Reports measured Pb and Cd (ppm) by AAS in single values for Libyan sidr, thyme, tamarisk and sugar-solution honeys; a fifth 'black honey' item is sugar-cane treacle per the paper and is excluded as not honey.
disposition_locator: Table 4 and Figure 4, p.7 (journal p.526); sampling description p.3 (journal p.522); black honey definition p.2 (journal p.521)

study.design: small convenience survey (apiary + local market), one value per honey type
study.material_scope: Sidr, thyme, tamarisk (athel) honey and 'honey solution' (bee-processed sugar syrup); 'black honey' (sugar-cane treacle) also analysed but excluded
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Study area Al-Khums and neighbours (Sahel, Silin), Libya. Sidr, thyme and honey-solution samples collected from apiaries near the area; tamarisk and black honey bought from the local market (origin of production not stated).
study.sampling_unit: honey-type samples (one reported value each; replicates not stated)
study.method: 1 g sample + 6 mL conc. HNO3 (65%) + 2 mL H2O2 (30%), microwave digestion, diluted to 25 mL, flame AAS (Varian 220G); calibration with Pb and Cd standards
study.basis: Not stated; assumed as-is honey weight (ppm = mg/kg).
study.qa: None reported (no CRM, recovery, blanks, or replicates).

controls.control: Hive siting away from roads/traffic and other pollution sources; use of compliant harvesting equipment
controls.comparator: tamarisk market sample vs other samples (no siting data provided)
controls.outcome: Authors attribute tamarisk Pb 1.55 ppm (above cited 1 ppm EC limit) to roadside fields, leaded fuel, fertilizers, pesticides, oil fields and non-compliant harvest equipment; speculative, not measured.

controls.control: Periodic testing of honey on the Libyan market against local/international specifications

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Summary treats 'black honey' (Pb 0.30, Cd 0.015 ppm) as a honey sample; the primary Introduction (journal p.521) states black honey is manufactured from the sugar-cane plant (treacle), so it is not bee honey and is excluded here.

Summary does not say that sidr, thyme and honey-solution samples came from apiaries near Al-Khums while tamarisk and black honey were bought on the local market (p.522); market vs production origin is therefore mixed.
Summary calls 'honey solution' 'sugar-solution honey' without flagging that it is bee-processed sugar syrup, not nectar honey.
Summary 'Methods (brief)' omits the digestion (HNO3/H2O2 microwave) and instrument (Varian 220G) details; no conflict in values.
unresolved: Number of samples or replicates per honey type not stated; each value is treated as a single sample value.
No collection date, LOD/LOQ or QA reported.

pdftotext output of this Arabic PDF scrambles digits (e.g. Table 4 Pb row extracts as '1231 1237 1241 1255 1265'); all values were read from rendered page images (pdftoppm, page 7) and agree with Figure 4 data labels and the text value 1.55 ppm.
Whether 'honey solution' (bee-processed sugar syrup) should count as honey for the ingredient page needs owner decision; excluded black honey values: Pb 0.30 ppm, Cd 0.015 ppm (Table 4).
